$description: Design tokens (PSP format: DTCG-inspired, CSS-ready string values, colors in OKLCH). `color` holds the DEFAULT theme's values — whatever Q13 chose as the default. A second theme lives under `themes.<mode>.color` as an override layer, so tooling emits ONE stable name per token (e.g. --color-background, bg-background) and swaps values per theme. Single-theme systems delete the `themes` block entirely. Numeric slots (scale ratio, line height) are emitted bare, not quoted.

accentForeground.$description: text/icons on an accent fill — must clear 4.5:1 on accent

borderStrong.$description: control boundaries (inputs, outlines) — must clear 3:1 on background (WCAG 1.4.11)
